sentences.text: With the consent of the parties, heard finally at motion stage.

2.This appeal has been filed by the appellant under Section 173 (1) of the Motor Vehicle Act, 1988 against the award dated 25.3.2022 passed in MACC No.261/2019 by Member Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Katni seeking enhancement of compensation.
3. Learned counsel for the appellant submits that the compensation awarded by the Tribunal is not just and proper.

On the date of accident, minimum wages of an unskilled labour were Rs.7375/-
whereas tribunal has determined monthly income as Rs.6500/-.Therefore, monthly income of the appellant be determined as Rs.7375/-.
Tribunal has not awarded any amount for loss of amenities.
Amount awarded under pain and suffering is on the lower side.
Therefore, compensation awarded by the Tribunal be suitably enhanced.
4. Learned counsel for the respondent insurance company submits that the amount awarded by the Tribunal is just and proper and no enhancement is required in the case.
5. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.
6. So far as income of appellant is concerned, on the date of accident, minimum wages of an unskilled labour were Rs.7375/- per month.
Therefore, monthly income of appellant is determined as Rs.7375/-.
In view of age of the appellant, 25% future prospects is to be added and multiplier of 14 is to be applied.
Tribunal has determined loss of future earning capacity as 20%.
No amount has been awarded for loss of amenities.

7. Hence, in view of above, compensation is re calculated as under:-
